tenderSchedule.title: Design, Manufacturing, Engineering, supply, Erection, installation, integrate, commissioning, and Testing of Central shaft Double Drum Winder
tenderSchedule.description: Design, Manufacturing, Engineering, supply, Erection, installation, integrate, commissioning, and Testing of Central shaft Double Drum Winder. As Per NIT Terms and Conditions
tenderSchedule.locationName: HGML Sr Manager Met Section Hutti

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
The document submitted by bidder in KPP Portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.

As per the Government Orders vide FD 417 EXP-12-2024 dated: 09-08-2024, the bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all Other applicable taxes, levies, duties, Cess etc. in the Kppp portal dashboard.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

technicalCriterionList.description: The firm should have successfully completed at least one contract work of supply and erection of winders/retrofit of winders with minimum 250 HP capacity and above in last five years (FY 2020 - 21 , 2021- 22 , 2022 - 23, 2023 - 24 & 2024 - 25). Copy of the relevant purchase orders along with performance certificate from the clients shall be enclosed.

The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should not be less than Rs.5.00 Crores, during the last three preceding financial years, namely: FY 2022-23 FY 2023-24 2024-25, The turnover certificate and financial statements certified by Chartered Accountant to be enclosed.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate, Profit & Loss statement and Balance sheet issued by the chartered Accountant for the year FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of ITR for the last three years i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
